description: This file implements a GUI menu widget for the Wesnoth game, including sorting, rendering, event handling, and item management.

classes.name: menu::basic_sorter
classes.description: A class for sorting menu items based on various criteria such as alphabetic, numeric, id, redirect, and position.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: A GUI widget class representing a scrollable menu with items, sorting, and event handling capabilities.
